simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְטִיל (H4300) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מְטִיל (mᵉṭîyl) means an iron bar (as forged) First listed occurrence: Job 40 18.

definitions.full: H4300. metil מְטִיל noun masculine wrought-metal rod (Aramaic ( ᵑ7 ) מְטָל ); — construct בַּרְזֶל מְטִיל Job 40:18 figurative of bones ( גְּרָמִים ) of hippopotamus (|| נְחֻשָׁה אֲפִיקֵי עֲצָמָיו ). מַטְמוֺן see טמן . מַטָּע see נטע . [ מַטְעָם ], מַטִעַמִּים see טעם . מִטְמַּ֫חַת see טפח .
definitions.rootNote: from 2904 in the sense of hammering out ;
